From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-17T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Reseller rider questions — signer authority and indemnity carveouts

Jonas — thanks. Short answers:

- Signer path: For marketplace addenda we typically accept signature from a delegated sales authority up to $250k ARR (VP Sales or above) if the rider contains Redwood-standard indemnity and liability caps. Anything that widens liability or removes our limitation requires GC countersignature.
- DocuSign: acceptable.
- Indemnity carveout for third-party hosted infra: we can consider a narrow carveout limited to direct, provable breaches of CloudRelay-managed infra; we will require evidence (incident timeline, forensic summary) and a commitment to remediation. Ops should own evidence retention and access.

Action: I attached the signer matrix template — please populate with CloudRelay's signer name/title and two backup approvers, then I can confirm if that fits our delegation. If they request a broader indemnity carveout or removal of cap, I will need to escalate to GC and that will add a delay.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signer_matrix_template.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)]

Emma — forwarding our internal guidance and attaching two items: my working draft of the rider (with the minimal edits Laura suggested) and a signer matrix template for you to populate.

Summary of our position:
- DocuSign is fine.
- If the rider remains Redwood-standard on caps/indemnity we can accept signature from your VP or Director-level authorized signer (please complete the signer matrix so Laura can confirm delegation).
- We can accept a narrow indemnity carveout limited to direct, provable breaches of CloudRelay-managed infra; however the carveout must be tightly scoped and tied to evidence retention and notification timelines.

Please return the completed signer matrix and any redlines to Section 6 by EOD Wednesday so we can keep the timeline. If you need GC countersignature we’ll flag it but try to avoid it to keep the signature window short.

Thanks for moving quickly on this.

—
